retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic fantasy composition featuring two contrasting characters reaching toward each other across a central 3D title, set against a dual-toned atmospheric landscape.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-fantasy scene divided diagonally by color and character: a pink-clad princess in the lower left under cherry blossoms, and a green-skinned witch in the upper right on a broomstick, both reaching toward a central, large-scale 3D beveled title.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized 3D typography as a visual bridge
Atmospheric depth with a distant castle silhouette
coreInvariants: High-contrast 3D beveling on the primary display text
Dual-tone color split across the composition
Ornate costume details including a crown and broomstick

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures at opposite corners (bottom-left and top-right) at medium-large scale, framing the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 3D title centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the reaching arms from the bottom-left princess to the top-right witch, passing through the central title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cloudy, atmospheric sky in the center-left and center-right provides breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm pink and peach (bottom-left) transitioning to cool emerald green (top-right).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark charcoal for the witch's attire and the title's inner face.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and metallic silver for the crown, broom, and title bevels.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the character elements against a desaturated, misty background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed serif with sharp, gothic-inspired terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Gradient fills within the letter faces (pink to green)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'W' features elongated, sharp vertical strokes
Terminals are angled to mimic blade-like points
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact 3D decorative display paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the sharp serif structure suitable for 3D modification.
Clean geometric base for the secondary wide-tracked text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic fantasy landscape with a split color palette: pink cherry blossoms and warm clouds on the left, dark green stormy clouds and a witch on a broom on the right. A distant golden castle sits in the center valley.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered 3D beveled title with sharp serifs. Apply a horizontal gradient from pink to green across the letters. Place secondary wide-tracked sans-serif text below the main title.

verificationChecks: Does the color transition from pink (left) to green (right)?
Are the characters positioned in the corners reaching toward the center?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink/green color split

mustAchieve: Clear visual distinction between the two character zones
avoid: Cluttered backgrounds that obscure the title

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D text has a metallic, beveled appearance.
Ensure the diagonal composition between the two figures is maintained.
Verify the gradient on the text matches the background color split.
Confirm the secondary text is legible and widely tracked.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Fantasy Split-Tone Layout + 3D Beveled Decorative Typography
